brief: Bootstrap an AI SaaS to $10k MRR. The lean path — niche, MVP, distribution, pricing, retention.

slots.headline: Bootstrapping AI SaaS to $10k MRR
slots.body: Identify a high‑impact problem where AI can automate a costly task. Focus on a tight market segment to validate quickly and build momentum.

slots.title: Find a Profitable Niche
slots.body: Research underserved markets where AI adds clear value. Target professionals willing to pay for automation, and validate demand before building.

slots.title: Build a Lean MVP
slots.body: Create a minimal product with one core AI feature. Focus on speed, collect feedback, and iterate quickly to meet real user needs.

slots.title: Validate with Early Users
slots.body: Leverage your network, forums, and LinkedIn groups to find early adopters. Offer free trials in exchange for honest feedback.

slots.title: Set Pricing for Growth
slots.body: Start with a simple subscription tier and test price points. Use value‑based pricing to align cost with the ROI your AI delivers.

slots.title: Drive Retention & Upsell
slots.body: Implement onboarding emails, in‑app tips, and regular check‑ins. Encourage upgrades by showcasing new features and success stories.

slots.title: Scale with Automation
slots.body: Automate onboarding, billing, and support with AI chatbots. Reinvest revenue into marketing channels that scale efficiently.

slots.headline: Start Your AI SaaS Journey
slots.body: Apply these steps, launch your MVP, and hit $10k MRR faster. Need help? Reach out.
